brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visited the United Arab Emirates, the Middle East Eye reported, marking a continuation of deepening diplomatic and military relations between Arab states and Israel. The visit reflects ongoing efforts by regional leaders to expand cooperation despite tensions in Gaza.

The trip occurs amid public discontent in Arab nations over governance issues and regional policy. Arab leaders' alignment with Israel carries political risks as populations grapple with separate concerns over repression and corruption within their own governments.

title: Netanyahu visits UAE as Arab leaders deepen ties with Israel
